                        # Already at target
                        pass
                else:
                    self.Liquidate(symbol)
            else:
                # Buy the stock
                if symbol in data and data[symbol].Price > 0:
                    buy_qty = int(target_value_per_stock / data[symbol].Price)
                    if buy_qty > 0:
                        self.SetHoldings(symbol, buy_qty)
                        self.Log(f"Buying {symbol}: {buy_qty} shares")
                else:
                    self.Log(f"Cannot buy {symbol}, price is 0 or missing.")

        self.Log(f"Rebalancing complete. Portfolio value: {total_cash}")

    def OnEndOfAlgorithm(self):
        """Called when the algorithm ends."""
        self.Log("Algorithm finished.")
